bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
cd "$HOME/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot"
root="$(pwd -P)"
stage=deploy/state/notice-pr81-cc91bef5
repo=seigo-gace/GateApp-Bot
target=cc91bef53d60b67f9bca01cc8d2d88fe067b9b71
old_sha=22c930f364bcec223a0a3ddca9d04dbadf74d1bc4cffe4d08494ef8e1a4311b7
new_sha=e4aa661715ed95e3e235ddef1dbd14f05d1978aa8ea2ff4195156dcb403ece32
localtag=gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:local
candidate=gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:notice-cc91bef5
rollback_tag=gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:rollback-notice-cc91bef5
for i in $(seq 1 15); do
  test -s "$stage/checkpoint.json" && break
  sleep 3
done
test -s "$stage/checkpoint.json"
test ! -e "$stage/live.json"
test "$(gh api repos/$repo/pulls/81 --jq '.head.sha')" = "$target"
for run in 46050629442 46050629450 46050629498 46050629563; do
  for i in $(seq 1 15); do
   status="$(gh run view "$run" -R "$repo" --json headSha,status,conclusion --jq '.headSha+" "+.status+" "+.conclusion')"
   [[ "$status" == "$target "* ]] || exit 43
   [[ "$status" == "$target completed "* ]] && break
   sleep 3
  done
  test "$status" = "$target completed success"
done
old_image="$(docker inspect -f '{{.Image}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)"
new_image="$(docker image inspect -f '{{.Id}}' "$candidate")"
export old_image old_sha new_image new_sha target stage
python3 - <<'PY'
import os,json,pathlib
j=json.loads((pathlib.Path(os.environ["stage"])/"checkpoint.json").read_text())
for k in ("old_image","old_sha","new_image","new_sha"):assert j[k]==os.environ[k],k
assert j["source_sha"]==os.environ["target"]
PY
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" = true
test "$(docker image inspect -f '{{.Id}}' "$localtag")" = "$old_image"
test "$(docker exec deploy-gaybbs-1 sha256sum /app/gaybbs.mjs | cut -d' ' -f1)" = "$old_sha"
test "$(docker run --rm --network none --entrypoint sha256sum "$candidate" /app/gaybbs.mjs | cut -d' ' -f1)" = "$new_sha"
pg_before="$(docker inspect -f '{{.Id}}' deploy-postgres-1)"
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' deploy-postgres-1)" = true
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active
ub_before="$(systemctl --user show -p MainPID --value gace-userbot-verify.service)"
test "$ub_before" != 0
pending(){
 docker exec -i deploy-gaybbs-1 node --input-type=module <<'JS'
import fs from 'node:fs';
import https from 'node:https';
const token=fs.readFileSync(process.env.BOT_TOKEN_FILE,'utf8').trim();
const count=await new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{
 const req=https.request('https://api.telegram.org/bot'+token+'/getWebhookInfo',{method:'POST',family:4,agent:false,timeout:12000,headers:{'content-type':'application/json','content-length':2}},res=>{
  let s='';res.on('data',c=>s+=c);res.on('end',()=>{try{const j=JSON.parse(s);if(!j.ok||j.result.url||!Number.isSafeInteger(j.result.pending_update_count))reject(Error('QUEUE_READ_FAILED'));else resolve(j.result.pending_update_count);}catch{reject(Error('QUEUE_READ_FAILED'));}});
 });
 req.on('timeout',()=>req.destroy());req.on('error',()=>reject(Error('QUEUE_READ_FAILED')));req.end('{}');
}).catch(()=>null);
if(count===null)process.exit(3);
console.log(count);
JS
}
before="$(pending)"
echo GAYBBS_PENDING_BEFORE="$before"
docker compose -p deploy -f "$root/deploy/gserver-compose.yaml" config -q
if docker image inspect "$rollback_tag" >/dev/null 2>&1; then test "$(docker image inspect -f '{{.Id}}' "$rollback_tag")" = "$old_image"; else docker tag "$old_image" "$rollback_tag"; fi
swapped=0
ok=0
cleanup(){
 rc=$?
 trap - EXIT
 if test "$swapped" = 1 && test "$ok" != 1; then
  docker tag "$rollback_tag" "$localtag"
  docker compose -p deploy -f "$root/deploy/gserver-compose.yaml" up -d --no-deps --no-build --force-recreate gaybbs >/dev/null
  echo GAYBBS_POLLING_ROLLBACK
 fi
 exit "$rc"
}
trap cleanup EXIT
docker tag "$candidate" "$localtag"
swapped=1
docker compose -p deploy -f "$root/deploy/gserver-compose.yaml" up -d --no-deps --no-build --force-recreate gaybbs >/dev/null
ready=0
for i in $(seq 1 24); do
 if docker logs --tail 300 deploy-gaybbs-1 2>&1 | grep -F 'GAYBBS_POLLING_READY' >/dev/null; then ready=1; break; fi
 sleep 3
done
test "$ready" = 1
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" = true
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.Image}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" = "$new_image"
test "$(docker exec deploy-gaybbs-1 sha256sum /app/gaybbs.mjs | cut -d' ' -f1)" = "$new_sha"
test "$(docker exec deploy-gaybbs-1 stat -c '%u:%g:%a' /app/gaybbs.mjs)" = 1000:1000:600
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.Id}}' deploy-postgres-1)" = "$pg_before"
test "$(systemctl --user show -p MainPID --value gace-userbot-verify.service)" = "$ub_before"
printf '{"source_sha":"%s","image":"%s","bundle_sha":"%s","rollback_image":"%s","state":"POLLING_READY"}\n' "$target" "$new_image" "$new_sha" "$old_image" > "$stage/live.json"
ok=1
echo GAYBBS_POLLING_DEPLOY=PASS
for i in $(seq 1 12); do
 after="$(pending)"
 echo GAYBBS_PENDING_OBSERVED="$after"
 test "$after" = 0 && break
 sleep 3
done
menu=FAIL
if python3 -B scripts/userbot_test_client.py bot_start_menu; then menu=PASS; fi
echo GAYBBS_MENU_TEST="$menu"
after="$(pending)"
echo GAYBBS_PENDING_AFTER="$after"
docker logs --tail 500 deploy-gaybbs-1 2>&1 | python3 -c 'import sys,re
s=sys.stdin.read()
print("GAYBBS_RECEIVED_BATCH_TOTAL",sum(map(int,re.findall(r"GAYBBS_UPDATE_BATCH_RECEIVED count=(\d+)",s))))
print("GAYBBS_HANDLER_ERROR_COUNT",s.count("[GAYBBS_ERROR]"))
'
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.Id}}' deploy-postgres-1)" = "$pg_before"
test "$(systemctl --user show -p MainPID --value gace-userbot-verify.service)" = "$ub_before"
echo DB_AND_USERBOT_UNCHANGED=PASS
test "$after" = 0
test "$menu" = PASS
echo GAYBBS_QUEUE_AND_MENU_ACCEPTED=PASS
